text_markup: The Corp uses the ability on {card:Tucana} to install and rez a copy of {card:Logjam} from R&D, paying a total of 3[c] less. They install the {card:Logjam} protecting a server that already has 1 piece of ice protecting it, meaning that without the "total of 3[c] less" modifier, the install cost would be 1[c] and the rez cost would be 6[c]. The Corp applies 1[c] of the discount to the install cost and 2[c] to the rez cost, leaving a final install cost of 0[c] and a final rez cost of 4[c].
